description.p: TrimFast cuts a video to the part you want without re-encoding it. Set an IN and an OUT point with the keyboard, then export: picture, audio, subtitles, chapters and metadata are copied exactly as they were (FFmpeg stream copy), and it is done in seconds.

It is a tool for tidying up clips you have already shot, not a video editor: no effects, no titles, no transitions. Insta360 .insv recordings are supported: both lens files are exported together and the camera's own data is kept.
Requires the ffmpeg and ffprobe programs to be installed.
